title: Moreish Puff Candy Drops Rainbow Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Taste the rainbow with Moreish Puff’s sweet, juicy and timeless flavour of Rainbow Candy. You can almost taste the crisp, hard candy shell and chewy taffy centre of your favourite rainbow sweets. Moreish Puff’s Nic Salt e-liquid’s nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and smooth throat hit provided by nic salts.
